A Parker & Pine Story

Johnny Builds
to Mars

1 · A bright idea

A wink from Mars

One wink from Mars in the velvety blue
made Johnny shout, “I can visit you!”
He sketched a ship by the moon’s silver light.
“A rocket by breakfast? That sounds about right.”

Tap all four twinkly stars

IDEA! Build a rocket! 🚀

2 · Supply safari

Pack the parts

He hunted the house from the den to the stair
for tape, wheels, and pillows—and one kitchen chair.
A colander helmet, a box, and some string…
If it rattled or rolled, it could probably fling!

Tap or drag each thing into the basket

3 · Garage genius

Clunk, tape, done!

He taped up the tail and he bolted the nose.
The dog raised one eyebrow and wiggled his toes.
“Four wheels?” asked the dog. “That seems quite a few.”
Johnny grinned, “You’re right—so I’ll only use two!”

Tap four parts to finish the rocket

…I have concerns. 🐶

4 · Blast off!

More zoom than plan

With goggles on tight and a howl from the hound,
Johnny pressed GO with a thunderous sound.
The garage gave a rattle. The flowerpots flew!
The rocket yelled “WHEEE!”—and the dog hollered too.

Press and hold for liftoff

5 · Mars at last

One tiny problem…

They bumped onto Mars with a bounce and a thud—
red dust on their elbows, red dust in the mud.
Johnny opened his lunchbox, then started to stare:
He packed half the garage… but no snacks were in there!

Tap Johnny’s lunchbox

WHEEE!

The End!

They found no snacks, but they found a grand view.
So they waved home to Earth… then back home they flew.
